result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` is now a second name for `updateLandscape`, and the CLI module compiles offline. I could not run the CLI to check the help output or an actual landscape run, because the sandbox refused the `java` invocations.

**What changed**

- `cli/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/cli/Commands.java`: added the `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` constant and a description saying it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. Added it to the no-argument overview, using the same landscape options.
- `cli/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/cli/CommandLineInterface.java`: `run()` dispatches `analyzeLandscape` to the same `updateLandscape` method. That method now takes the command name and description as parameters, so `-help` prints the usage under the name the user typed. `updateLandscape -help` still prints its own usage.

**README:** it has no command descriptions (only a build note and a Docker `init` example), so I left it unchanged. If you want a commands section added, I can write one.

**Not verified:** the cli module has no tests, and I did not run `analyzeLandscape -help` or a landscape run. Please run `java -jar cli/target/sokrates.jar analyzeLandscape -help` after the next build, and check that `analyzeLandscape -analysisRoot <folder>` writes `_sokrates_landscape/config.json` and `index.html`.

Nothing is committed.
